## Hi there!
I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at the [University of Nottingham Ningbo China](https://www.nottingham.edu.cn/) and a member of [Centre for Decision Research and Experimental Economics (CeDEx) China](https://www.nottingham.edu.cn/en/humanities-and-social-sciences/schools-and-department/economics/research/research-centres/cedex-china/home.aspx). I received my Master’s degree from [University of Southampton](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/) and my Bachelor’s degree from Jilin University, Zhuhai College. My research interests span labour economics, experimental economics, and behavioural economics, with a particular focus on how self-perception shapes individual decision-making.

:::
